zap.intro: Take a photo of your notebook or paste text. Evklid makes you a quiz and flashcards.
zap.privacy: Only notes in the photo – no faces or names. We don't keep the photo.
zap.max: At most 5 pages at a time.
zap.pagesLeft: Photos this month: {left} of {limit} left. Pasted text doesn't count.
zap.check: Did I read it right? Fix anything that's wrong.
zap.pastePh: Paste or type your notes here …
zap.making: Finding the topics and preparing a quiz and flashcards …
zap.noTopics: I didn't find these topics on the learning path, so there is no quiz.
zap.quizHint: Tasks from Evklid's practice for these topics.
zap.wrong: Not correct. The right answer is marked.
zap.cardsAdded: The flashcards are in your Flashcards, in the set »{title}«.
zap.noCards: I can't make flashcards from these notes right now.
zap.printed: We don't keep the text of printed pages – only the topics and flashcards.
zap.empty: You have no saved notes yet.
zap.deleteAsk: Delete the notes »{title}« and their flashcards?
zap.errRead: I can't read this. Take the photo closer and in better light.
zap.errSubject: Evklid knows maths, physics, chemistry and biology. It doesn't know this subject yet.
zap.errPages: You've used all photos this month. You get new ones on {date}. You can still paste text.
zap.errEmpty: I didn't find anything in the notes for a quiz or flashcards.
zap.errNoPhoto: Reading photos isn't available here. Paste the text.
zap.aiOff: I can't make flashcards right now (usage limit). The practice quiz still works.
